source.quote_free_summary: A contest restart (for example incorrect song, clothing malfunction, sound or lighting issue) may be initiated by the Chief Judge or the competitor but is approved only by the Chief Judge, who may allow it immediately or later, for example at the end of the contest.

requirement: A restart re-runs an executed heat; this design never alters executed heats, so restarts are out of scope. A future restart record linked to the original heat and approved by the designated Chief Judge is a separate design.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. The O1 heat state machine is forward only.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a blocker to WSDC profile activation for restarts. Chief Judge approval authority is the WSDC role designated under OD-06 (PR 834).
